title: Database N+1 Query Smell (Redundant Roundtrips)
damaged_code:
```ruby
# ORM ActiveRecord style
employees = Employee.all # Query 1
employees.each do |employee|
    skills = employee.skills # Queries N
end
```
pattern: Accessing a lazy-loaded collection attribute of multiple parent objects inside a loop, triggering one SQL query for the list and then N individual SQL queries to fetch each member.
why_bad: Forces N independent network roundtrips to the database engine, incurring massive communication overhead and wasting query optimizer capacity on repetitive queries.
detection: Loops iterating over a persistent database entity array where each step triggers a database query based on the current element's primary or foreign key.
counterexample: The database is fully cached in memory, or the collection is tiny (< 2 elements). `Context-dependent`.
fix: Eager-load or join the dependent collections in a single SQL query (`SELECT ... JOIN ...`) or compile-time views.
source: *Release It!*, Section 9.7 (p. 246 / 537) and *Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture*, Structural Mapping Patterns (p. 563-565).
